summary: Verified CSS z-index fix for mobile stay detail page: Leaflet map +/- zoom controls stacked below the sticky Reserve bar. Also validated desktop regression (zoom controls work, no mobile booking bar).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and scoped correctly to .sx-dmap so it does not impact the stays listing map (.sx-map). Good targeting.
Reserve bar z-index:600 > zoom controls z-index:500 confirmed via computed styles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile stacking fix verified at 390x760. Reserve bar sits above Leaflet zoom controls (bar z=600, .sx-dmap .leaflet-top/.leaflet-bottom z=500). Reserve button is topmost element at its center point (confirmed via elementFromPoint). Button is clickable and opens 'Your trip' modal. Desktop 1280x800: mobile-booking-bar hidden, book-this-stay sticky card visible, map zoom +/- clickable.
